spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact trial surface (navigator.rtc / startDiagnosticLogging from Chromium rtc.idl), the [SecureContext] gate, and names the real runtime feature RTCDiagnosticLogging and enterprise policy from runtime_enabled_features.json5 and the chromestatus entry.

interactive.rationale: Live re-probe button updates four readout cells; the token input regenerates meta-tag and header snippets on every keystroke; two copy buttons write to the clipboard with visible + aria-live feedback.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb promises an enablement-gate tool with probe plus snippet builder; the page delivers exactly those two panels plus the no-token alternatives.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers non-secure-context impossibility, flag-vs-token-vs-policy distinction, the policy-opacity guarantee (page cannot observe collection authorization), and clipboard failure fallback text.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376; the concept links the origin-trials console, the enterprise policy, and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: New v151 suite asserts the navigator.rtc trial surface, all three methods, the secure-context gate, a real start-resolves-UUID call, metadata-limit rejection, and an explicit draft-statics divergence watch.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: typed a token, clicked Re-probe, verified generated snippets and honest 'API not exposed here' verdict; zero console errors/exceptions, 0px horizontal overflow at 1280 and 360 widths; before/after screenshots read and checked.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert('rtc-onramp-probe-ran') fires with the probe booleans; no console noise on load or interaction.

design_system.rationale: All colours are styles.css variables; probe verdicts use accent-emerald/rose on paper backgrounds (AA); buttons keep the global dark bg + ivory text.

accessibility.rationale: Native button/input controls with a visible label for the token field; probe status and copy feedback are role=status aria-live regions; headings structure the three numbered steps.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000 runs both show no horizontal overflow, no clipped controls, single-column probe grid on mobile; only network failure in the harness is the sandbox-blocked Google Fonts CDN, present on every page of the site.

openQuestions.title: Verify the real success path behind the flag once a Chrome ≥150 binary is available
openQuestions.detail: The verification environment ships Chromium 141, which predates the RTCDiagnosticLogging runtime feature, so only the honest-unavailable path could be exercised. When a newer Chrome/Canary is available, relaunch with --enable-blink-features=RTCDiagnosticLogging and confirm the probe flips to 'API callable here'.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce dynamic state changes through role=status / aria-live regions and keep interactive controls native with programmatic labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe status line and both copy-feedback notes are role=status aria-live=polite; the token field has an explicit <label>; all controls are native buttons/inputs.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless CDP finalEval lists the status texts under [role=status],[aria-live].

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive button row control panel small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap/grid with intrinsic sizing instead of fixed widths so control rows reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe grid is 1-column under 640px and 2-column above; control rows use flex-wrap; long tokens use overflow-wrap:anywhere — verified 0px horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button accessible feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair clipboard writes with visible, announced confirmation and a graceful failure path.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Copy buttons write via navigator.clipboard and report 'copied ✓' or the failure name in an aria-live note that clears after 2.5s.

summary: Built and verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): Chromium 141 CDP drive typed a token, regenerated both snippets, re-probed, and confirmed the honest unavailable verdict with a clean console and no overflow at mobile or desktop width. The real flag-on success path is not verifiable on Chromium 141 and is recorded as an open question.
